title: Parking Fee Calculation
overview: The checkout component produces a deterministic fee quote for an OPEN ticket using one pricing-rule version.
preconditions: The ticket exists with OPEN status.
main_flow: The cashier submits a ticket ID.
The system calculates elapsed time using the server clock.
The system applies grace period, rounded-up hourly pricing, and daily caps.
The system returns a detailed quote.

alternative_flows.condition: The ticket is inside the grace period.
The ticket is unknown or CLOSED.
alternative_flows.result: Reject the request with a ticket-state error.

business_rules: A partial hour after grace is rounded up.
